headline: Nvidia Launches Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Open Bolt Models
dek: A 120B-parameter model and Bolt versions built to run outside the cloud ship with open weights, Nvidia says.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: One large model, two smaller ones
body: Nvidia released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open-weight, 120-billion-parameter model for always-on AI agents (NVIDIA, SiliconANGLE, ZDNet).
Two smaller Bolt models arrived alongside it, designed to run outside the cloud.

s3.label: How it works
s3.title: The Bolt models
s3.body: According to Nvidia and SiliconANGLE, the Bolt line runs on local hardware.

points.t: Available now; fits in 24GB of memory with 2-bit quantization (NVIDIA, SiliconANGLE, ZDNet).
At 4GB, arrives Oct. 23 for voice assistants and devices (NVIDIA, SiliconANGLE).
Runs research and coding agents without sending data to the cloud, Nvidia says.

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: Speed, per Nvidia
body: Nvidia says Super VL runs about five times faster than the next-best model in its class.
According to ZDNet, the result comes from Artificial Analysis testing. The company also says it will publish training data and recipes.

stat.cap: faster than the next in class, Nvidia says

items.t: Can be post-trained on an organization's own data, per Nvidia.
Run behind a company's own firewall (NVIDIA, SiliconANGLE).
Super VL ships as a microservice with biweekly security updates, Nvidia says.

caption.hook: Nvidia launched Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120-billion-parameter model, plus two Bolt models.
body: According to Nvidia, SiliconANGLE and ZDNet, Bolt 74B is available now and fits in 24GB of memory with 2-bit quantization. The 4GB Bolt E4B arrives Oct. 23.

Nvidia says Super VL runs about five times faster than the next-best model in its class, based on Artificial Analysis testing cited by ZDNet. Weights, data and training recipes will be open, and organizations can run the models on their own infrastructure. Nvidia also packages Super VL as a production-ready microservice.
